status: retrospective existing-data translation/deformation analysis; no new simulation and no exponent fit
interpretation_boundary: T_i is the pooled-density tangent for a first-order threshold-location shift with the observed area. R_i measures finite-archive distributional reshaping. Neither component alone identifies a continuum operator.

decision_covariance.rule: same deleted batch across both orientations and all N in one dependency group; zero entries across independent groups

descriptive_findings.guard: Signs and energy shares are finite-archive estimates with aligned delete-one covariance; no cross-size exponent is fitted.
